text:
lucy: Planning a config-only quiet deploy tonight at 02:00 UTC. Scope: per-route timeout reduction, routing weight tilts, and batching window shrink for high-throughput routes. No model binary changes. Deploy will be a canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation windows.

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-only/turn-down-batch-2026-03 | canary targets: svc-rt-us-east-1a (10%)

omar: what's the exact batching/window change? worried about latency for short-chat flows.

lucy: shrinking batching window from 80ms -> 40ms for routes: /generate, /chat-stream. Keep short_sequence heuristic enabled. This should reduce tail latency for interactive users; small hit to throughput.

sophia: can we pin the model variant for the canary? last time variant float gave noisy perf.

lucy: good call. canary pinned to redwood/gpt-medium-8qv1@v2 for this rollout. full rollout will be compatible fallbacks only.

kevin: cooling question — rollback plan if p99 spikes? numbers to watch?

lucy: watch p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate (5xx), and token throughput. thresholds: p99 > 1200ms OR error_rate > 0.8% => immediate rollback to previous routing config. Also watch cost-per-token dev dashboard but not blocking.

lucy: rollback commands (ops):
```
# revert routing weight
redwoodctl routing set-weight --route=/generate --variant=stable --weight=100
# restore batching window
redwoodctl config set --path=/optimizers/batching/window_ms --value=80
```

omar: ok. do we have an automated healthcheck watching p99? can deploy-bot post alerts when thresholds hit?

deploy-bot: healthcheck configured: monitors/eng-releases/canary-batch-2026-03
alerts: p99_latency > 1200ms for 3m OR error_rate > 0.8% for 5m -> #eng-oncall and this thread.

sophia: also suggest lowering routing tilt for europe routes during canary: make eu weight 5% until 50% step.

lucy: agreed. will reduce eu tilt to 5% initially. adding to checklist.

lucy: checklist snapshot:
- [x] config change committed: git sha 9f2a1b8
- [x] canary pin set to v2
- [x] healthcheck rules created
- [x] rollback commands posted
- [ ] watch for anomalies (first 15m).

kevin: if we see moderate p99 drift but stable errors, prefer slowing rollout to 25% rather than immediate revert?

lucy: yes, escalation plan: minor drift (p99 900-1200ms, errors <0.3%) -> pause at current step and extend observation to 30m. Major drift -> immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: canary results: 10% canary healthy after 15m. p99 760ms, errors 0.12%, throughput -4%. Proceed to 50% in 10m unless anyone objects.

omar: thumbs up from me. :+1:

sophia: +1

kevin: +1

lucy: advancing to 50%.

deploy-bot: rollout: progressed to 50% at 02:28 UTC

deploy-bot: alert: p99 latency trending up on /chat-stream in us-west-2, now 1100ms for 5m. Posting to thread.

omar: seeing the same in traces, tail packets show smaller batch sizes but more frequent kernel stalls.

lucy: pausing rollout at 50%. can someone run quick trace on host pool us-west-2-gpu-03?

sophia: running traces now. suspect kernel mismatch on quantized path. adding engine team.

lucy: decision: pause at 50%, revert the routing tilt for us-west-2 to previous weights (from 30% -> 10%) and extend observation 20m. If p99 crosses 1200ms revert fully.

deploy-bot: action executed: routing weights adjusted for /chat-stream in us-west-2 -> 10% at 02:45 UTC

kevin: good call. keep rollback cmds ready in case it gets worse.

lucy: logging this as a config-only pause. I'll open a follow-up postmortem if we end up reverting. For now watch the healthcheck; I'll update in 10m.

deploy-bot: canary paused at 50% (02:46 UTC). Monitoring continues.

sophia: attaching quick snippet from traces:
```
trace_id: a1b2c3
spans: kernel-compile(120ms) -> kv-cache(40ms) -> tokenize(10ms)
note: kernel-compile tail events increased on us-west-2
```

omar: thanks. sounds like we should file an eng-runtime ticket to look at quantized kernel selection on that pool.

lucy: filed: ENG-RUNTIME-1428. assigning to @ammar and @julia.

lucy: update: after reducing us-west-2 tilt p99 stabilized to 820ms, error rate 0.18%. keeping paused at 50% for another 10m then will reassess.

kevin: fine by me.

deploy-bot: last check (03:10 UTC): p99 815ms, errors 0.17%, token throughput -3%. No rollback triggered.

lucy: thanks team. I'll coordinate a low-risk followup: re-run the canary next maintenance with an eng-runtime fix and consider reverting the batching window change if we can't get kernel path stable.

omar: thx all. good ops.
